chunks: And from him, from Muhammad, from Saif ibn 'Amirah, from Mansur ibn Hazim, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
"When you are in the state of Tamattu', do not approach anything that has yellow color until you perform Tawaf around the House."

key_terms.مُتَمَتِّعاً: A pilgrim performing Hajj al-Tamattu' (combining Umrah and Hajj)

ai.seo_question: What is the prohibition regarding yellow clothing or items for a pilgrim performing Tamattu' before Tawaf?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) specifies a prohibition on wearing or approaching yellow-colored garments during the state of Ihram for Hajj al-Tamattu', remaining in effect until the completion of Tawaf al-Ifadah. This ruling highlights the distinct ritual purity and aesthetic restrictions observed by pilgrims, distinguishing the Tamattu' mode from other forms of Hajj. It underscores the meticulous attention to detail in Shia fiqh regarding the visual and physical state of the pilgrim during sacred rites.
